title: review finding facts
description: The facts a reviewer states about one finding. The reviewer supplies facts only; severity and blocking are computed from them by the evaluator. Every value is drawn from a closed list, and a missing, invalid or unknown value is resolved to the worst case for its dimension, so leaving a fact out never makes a finding look milder.

category.description: The rulebook rule family the finding belongs to.

cwe.description: OPTIONAL weakness identifier, for example CWE-79.

reachable.description: Whether the defective code can be reached with attacker-influenced input.

attacker_precondition.description: What the attacker must already be able to do to trigger the defect.

impact.description: What the defect costs, per dimension.

durability.description: Whether the damage persists (durable) or ends when the triggering condition does (ephemeral).

evidence.description: OPTIONAL short statement of what the reviewer observed that supports these facts.
